groups.activity: unlock the Zariman and The Holdfasts
groups.meta: The New War → Angels of the Zariman
conditions: There is no shortcut around these quests: Felarx's blueprint and all of its dedicated build materials come from Zariman progression.

groups.sub: Chrysalith: turn Voidplumes in to Archimedean Yonta
groups.activity: Exterminate; sweep the map after the objective
groups.meta: daily standing cap is the hard gate

rows.label: Voidplumes turned in to Archimedean Yonta
rows.note: Pinion 5,000, Quill 2,500, Crest 2,000, Vane 1,000, Down 500 standing each

conditions: Rank-ups consume 5,000, 22,000 and 44,000 standing, and the blueprint costs another 8,000.

disclosures.title: calendar, not RNG, sets the floor
disclosures.body: Even with enough plumes ready, the rank purchases and blueprint require several daily cap resets. Expect at least four days at cap, and roughly a week when Crests or Lanthorns lag behind.

rows.label: Felarx Blueprint
rows.alt: a clanmate can gift or trade the blueprint

conditions: You must reach Guardian to buy it yourself. Trading the blueprint skips that purchase, but not the Zariman-only build materials.

rows.label: Felarx
rows.note: 30,000 cr, 10 Voidplume Pinion, 15 Voidplume Quill, 30 Voidgel Orb, 8,000 Alloy Plate

conditions: You may craft Felarx before Mastery Rank 14, but cannot equip it until then.

rows.label: Void Angel primary-fire headshots without reloading
Solo mission with Incarnon weapons in every slot

conditions: Evolution progress persists across missions. Perks can be changed freely at Cavalero or in the Arsenal.
For Evolution III, multishot pellets count individually; stack magazine size and multishot. Incarnon form counts as primary fire.
Do these as solo or host when possible: clients have reported progress failing to register. Exalted weapons do not satisfy Evolution V.
bonuses: Felarx, Laetum, and Innodem together make Evolution V easy for future native Incarnons.
